dialogueEntries.text: It’s a nice day today.
The sun feels warm on your shoulders.
Today was... fun. It nearly made you forget about the anomaly that was this morning.
Going home now... you'll have to face your dad. You don't feel ready to do that.
You get a text from an unknown number. It reads: hii it's ash. ik we JUST talked, but are you free today? there's a cool spot not far from here i wanna show you.
You're about to reply when you see Ella running up to you.
You catch sight of Ella running up to you.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: You're kidding...

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: Hey! Ayla! Wait up!

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: We didn't get to finish our conversation earlier. I just wanted to clear things up between us.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: If I said anything, I meant no harm by it. Do you have time to talk now?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Are you joking...?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: I'm not! Me and Dina wanted to grab boba together. You can come with?
Whether it's with Ella or Ash, it'd be nice to delay going home for a little while.
Whether it's with Ella or Ash, it'd be nice to delay going home for a little while.
You have nothing better to do... it beats going home

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Ok. Fine, I'll get boba with you guys.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: Yes!! Come on, Dina is waiting over there. It's not a far walk.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: Yes!! Come on, Dina is waiting over there. It's not a far walk.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Sorry, I promised somebody else I'd meet them. Maybe some other time.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: Oh, okay. You still have my number, right? If you change your mind, or wanna talk, just text me.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Will do.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Will do.
